services.name: Day Pass
services.desc: Pirate Water Taxi offers daily tours of Tampa with many stops located along our route near attractions, museums, restaurants & parks! Simply buy tickets at our home dock (Stop #7 - Convention Center), online or after boarding the taxi at any of the stops located throughout Downtown Tampa. Once purchased, you will receive a Pirate Water Taxi wristband which allows you to hop on and off the taxi at any stop for unlimited rides - all day! These wristbands also give you discounts with a number of venues located on the route as part of our Pirate Perks

services.name: private charter
services.desc: Experience the best of Downtown Tampa from the water! Whether you need a scenic party boat or a dedicated shuttle, our private charters are now available for online booking. Looking for a unique way to celebrate? Host your next event on the scenic Hillsborough River. Pirate Water Taxi offers private group charters tailored to your schedule. From corporate outings to birthday celebrations and sunset cruises, we provide a one-of-a-kind floating venue with the best views of the Tampa skyline. Pirate Water Taxi private charters are perfect for your next Downtown Tampa outing. Setting sail weekly from stop 7 at the convention center, this 1-hour and 30-minute sunset cruise will delight guests with amazing Tampa Bay sunset.
